20001.name: Flicker
20001.description: Teleport a short distance in the specified direction; gains +5 Hybrid Defense for 1s

20002.name: Retribution
20002.description: Deals 1500-2400 True Damage to creeps/minions and slows enemy heroes

20003.name: Inspire
20003.description: Increases Attack Speed by 500% (caps at 5.0) and ignores 8 physical defense on next 8 basic attacks

20004.name: Sprint
20004.description: +50% Movement Speed decaying over 6s; immune to Slow effects (INUMM_DECSPEED = 31)

20005.name: Revitalize
20005.description: Summons a Healing Spring restoring 2.5% Max HP per second to nearby allies

20006.name: Aegis
20006.description: Gains a 750 (+50*Level) shield for 3s and shields the lowest HP nearby ally for 70%

20007.name: Petrify
20007.description: Petrifies nearby enemies for 0.8s and slows them by 50% for 0.8s

20008.name: Purify
20008.description: Immediately removes all crowd control (except Suppression) and gains CC Immunity (INUMM_CONTROL = 30) and +15% Move Speed for 1.2s

20009.name: Flameshot
20009.description: Fires a flaming shot dealing 200-640 (+40%-160% AP) Magic Damage and knocks back nearby enemies

20010.name: Vengeance
20010.description: Gains 35% Damage Reduction and reflects 35% of damage received back to attacker as Magic Damage

20011.name: Arrival
20011.description: Channels for 3s to teleport to an allied turret or minion; grants +60% Movement Speed decaying over 3s
